models_evaluated: equal-weight score-level ensemble of two CNNs

links.outcome: Missed parasitized cells and sensitivity at default vs F2-optimized decision threshold
links.effect: F2-optimized threshold on validation data gave 97.05% sensitivity (95% CI 96.23%-97.70%), 2.95% false-negative rate; missed parasitized cells fell from 177 to 61 versus default threshold.
links.quote: It reduced missed parasitized cells from 177 to 61 relative to its default threshold.

unlisted_practices: Recall-weighted F2 objective for selecting sensitivity-oriented operating point using validation data only

screen.practice: alert/operating threshold selection (sensitivity-oriented F2 threshold optimization)
screen.reason: Evaluates operating threshold selection (recall-weighted F2 vs conventional threshold) to reduce missed clinical diagnoses on a microscopy benchmark.
